sections.Profile:
"Hot Shots" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1989. It is part of the Gottlieb System 80B series and features a basketball theme. The game has two flippers, one ramp, and supports a two-ball multiball mode. Designed by Jon Norris with artwork by Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell, 2,342 units were produced.
